SQL aur NoSQL databases ka main difference yeh hai:

SQL databases, jaise MySQL ya PostgreSQL, structured hote hain. Inmein data tables mein store hota hai, rows aur columns ke saath. Ek fixed schema hota hai, matlab data ka structure pehle se define karna padta hai. Yeh relational databases hote hain aur consistency ke liye achhe hain.

NoSQL databases, jaise MongoDB ya Cassandra, unstructured ya semi-structured data ke liye hote hain. Inka koi fixed schema nahi hota, toh yeh flexible hote hain aur alag-alag formats mein data store kar sakte hain (jaise documents, key-value pairs, graphs). Yeh scalability ke liye achhe maane jaate hain.

Basically, SQL structured data ke liye, NoSQL flexible data ke liye.
